keyPoints: Jantuon me bhojan ka pachan muh se shuru hota hai — daant kaat te hain, laar (saliva) starch ko saral banati hai — aur aanton me poora hota hai.
Aamashay ka aml aur yakrit ka pitta ras bhojan ko aur saral banate hain; chhoti aant me pachan poora hokar poshak tatva khoon me mil jaate hain.
Shwasan me jeev oxygen lete hain aur carbon dioxide chhodte hain; koshikaon me bhojan ke dahna se urja milti hai jo har kaam me kharch hoti hai.
Rakt parivahan ka kaam karta hai — hriday pump ki tarah lagatar dhadakkar rakt ko sharir ke kone-kone tak pahunchata hai.
Gurde (kidneys) rakt ko chhankar bekar padarth mootra ke roop me bahar nikaalte hain; paseena nikalna bhi utsarjan ka ek tareeka hai.
Manav hriday ke chaar kaksh hote hain; dhamniyan shuddh rakt angon tak le jaati hain aur shiraen ashuddh rakt wapas laati hain.
Aam galti: shwasan aur saans lena ko ek samajhna; saans lena hawa ka andar-bahar aana hai, jabki shwasan koshika ke andar bhojan se urja banane ki prakriya hai.

title: Jantuon me Jeevan Prakriyayein
